summary.text: Lisa Kaul is the Democratic and Working Families Party candidate for New York State Senate District 39 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She has served on the Dutchess County Legislature since 2023, according to her Ballotpedia survey, and chairs its Environment committee.

paragraphs.text: Kaul earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Delhi and a Ph.D. from the University of Oxford, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Kaul said she grew up in India, the daughter of a teacher and a career army officer, and earned her doctorate at Oxford with a Rhodes Scholarship.
She said she moved to the United States in 2004, settled in Poughkeepsie and has since served on a board of education and founded a Repair Cafe.
She also said she serves on the board of the Planned Parenthood Greater New York Action Fund.
Kaul said her campaign is focused on the costs of housing, energy and health care in the Hudson Valley.
She listed building affordable housing, rejecting utility rate hikes, universal child care, public schools, public transportation and clean energy among her priorities.
